scope.warning: Any hammam work not already included must fit the envelope or be added explicitly.

financing_plan.repayment_method_test: linear principal repayment with interest on opening balance
financing_plan.warning: The SCI and operating-company accounts require separate agreements and repayment schedules. The 4.33% input is an adjustable fiscal reference, not a promised return; 10% annual is retained only as a stress test requiring legal, tax and accounting validation.

accounting_and_cash_treatment.principal_repayment: cash outflow and balance-sheet movement, not operating expense
accounting_and_cash_treatment.interest: financial expense of the debtor entity, subject to agreement and validation
accounting_and_cash_treatment.entity_separation: SCI repayments are not operating-company repayments; the rent is an inter-entity flow governed by the lease

excluded: working capital beyond the stated annual reserve
financing costs beyond the adjustable current-account simulation
hammam work not already included in the documented items
